name: Biosignatures & Life Detection
summary: How we could detect life remotely or in samples: chemical, morphological and atmospheric biosignatures, false positives and the instruments that search for them.

topics.name: Types of biosignatures: morphological, chemical, isotopic and atmospheric
Fossil and mineral biosignatures, and the debate over the earliest life
Atmospheric biosignatures: oxygen, ozone, methane and disequilibrium
Agnostic biosignatures: molecular complexity and assembly theory
Life-detection instruments: mass spectrometry, Raman and microscopy
Mission case studies: Viking, Perseverance, Europa Clipper, Dragonfly, JWST
Frameworks for claiming life: confidence scales and standards of evidence
